visual: Grey downy leaves and stems · large soft pink mallow flowers all summer
water: Water while establishing · sparingly after that
soilWarning: Winter wet is what kills it
prune: Cut hard back in spring to a low permanent framework
hardinessNote: Hardy in most UK locations, approximately -15 to -10°C; shelter from severe cold winds is beneficial.
resilience: Fast and very free-flowering · shrubby mallows are often short-lived
uses: Sunny borders · cottage gardens · pollinators · fast summer colour
uncertain: Often still sold as Lavatera 'Rosea', Lavatera × clementii 'Rosea' or Lavatera olbia 'Rosea'; RHS currently accepts Malva × clementii 'Rosea'.
peak: supplied research said "Summer to early autumn"; converted to Jun-Sep so the app can parse it. Not from a source that stated months.
latin: cultivar moved from cvs into latin to match the deck's convention.
